title: Dono ka ek hi number baaki!
format: Kitty Gang sitcom at the theme's Housie

experiment.hook: cold open on the game, 1 number left
experiment.variable: Kitty Gang characters instead of only the app screen
experiment.hypothesis: faces and a rivalry in the first 2 s cut the skip rate under 60%

idea: Tanya and Ruhi both need 44 for Full House in Spooky Web Housie; 13 comes, then 44, Tanya wins.
beats: hook: 1 number left / setup: both need 44 / escalation: 13 comes / turn: 3-2-1 reveal / button: Ruhi's excuse
caption: Ek number, do saheliyan, aur {theme} ki raat. Aapke group mein Ruhi kaun hai? Tag karo!

lines.say: बस चवालीस चाहिए, फिर फुल हाउस!
मेरा भी चवालीस ही बाकी है!

lines.text: Full House! Spider Web bhi mera!
lines.say: फुल हाउस! स्पाइडर वेब भी मेरा!

lines.text: Main toh bas haaye karne aayi thi.
lines.say: मैं तो बस हाय करने आई थी।
